ingestors.name: live_binance
ingestors.rationale: Binance public market data (OHLCV, depth, mark price, funding) consumed by V2 native v2_market_ingestor through public REST/WSS endpoints. No API key required. Closed for paper-only shutdown as native public-data.

ingestors.name: live_binance_liquidations
ingestors.rationale: Binance liquidations consumed by V2 native bridge from public WSS !forceOrder stream; no secret required. Closed for paper-only shutdown as native public-data.

ingestors.name: live_coinank
ingestors.rationale: CoinAnk REST requires an API key. With COINANK_API_KEY present, V2 consumes it as native public read-only data via v2_coinank_and_liquidation_bridge. Without the key, classification is BLOCKED_BY_SECRET_OR_API.

ingestors.name: live_coinank_global_aggregator
ingestors.rationale: Aggregator scope (global symbol universe) requires operator decision on quota pressure and symbol set before V2 spins it up. Explicitly marked as a paper-only shutdown decision item.

ingestors.name: live_kucoin
ingestors.rationale: KuCoin public-data ingestor implemented natively in V2 via v2_kucoin_ingestor_worker (public REST + WSS, no API key required). Spot ticker, klines, orderbook20, and futures funding/OI/mark configuration emitted with deterministic V2 symbol mapping and reconnect backoff.

ingestors.name: live_coinapi_v1
ingestors.rationale: CoinAPI v1 requires X-CoinAPI-Key (COINAPI_API_KEY or COINAPI_KEY). With the key present, V2 may consume free-tier read-only market data. Without the key it is BLOCKED_BY_SECRET_OR_API.

ingestors.name: live_coinapi_wsds
ingestors.rationale: CoinAPI WSDS is a paid streaming subscription. Even with the key present, operator must approve the paid tier and the bandwidth caps. Explicitly tracked as a paper-only shutdown decision item.

ingestors.name: live_technical_analysis
ingestors.rationale: Technical analysis pipeline is fully native in V2 via v2_feature_pipeline_and_ta_worker + v2_feature_pipeline_native_trainer_snapshot. No legacy dependency.

ingestors.name: realtime_price_provider
ingestors.rationale: Realtime price layer is served by v2_market_ingestor in V2 with native OHLCV cache.

ingestors.name: liquidation_bridge
ingestors.rationale: Bridge in V2 (v2_coinank_and_liquidation_bridge) consumes existing public liquidation streams; no separate rate pressure. Closed for paper-only shutdown as native read-only public-data.

ingestors.name: liquidation_levels_engine
ingestors.rationale: Liquidation levels are computed natively in V2 against the V2 OHLCV cache. No legacy import.

ingestors.name: ccxt_historical
ingestors.rationale: CCXT historical fetches are used only for backfill. The V2 backtest path is already covered by the local replay store; promoting ccxt into V2 venv is an operator-level decision (dependency surface vs subprocess boundary). Explicitly tracked as a paper-only shutdown decision item.
